description: Returns every profile you are currently monitoring, with its handle, platform, follower count, refresh cadence, next scheduled crawl time, when it was last checked for updates, and any paused reason (e.g. paused for insufficient credits). Free to call. Use it to audit what is being refreshed and what it is costing, or to grab a profileId for untrack_profile. Cost: free.
name: list_tracked_profiles
title: List Monitored Profiles
